_comment: Per-(method/dataset/error_class) minimum recall floors for the coverage regression gate. Floors are seeded from a verified full-RAHA `dataforge bench --quick` run and lock in current coverage so it cannot silently regress. Detection floors (@detection) credit flagging the error; plain keys credit exact correction. INVESTIGATED 2026-07-11: the flights text_normalization slice (n=1729) is NOT a normalization slice - it is act_dep_time/act_arr_time value errors (e.g. '9:22 a.m.' -> '9:32 a.m.') that the labeler tags text_normalization only because they are within edit-distance 2 as strings. The correct time is not derivable in-table (no dominant in-column canonical, no intra-row signal), so this is an ABSTENTION slice (not_inferable_from_prompt), not a detection lever. A precision-preserving normalization detector recovers 0/1729 here and 0/423 on hospital, so no such detector is shipped; the honest lever for this slice is calibrated abstention (dataforge.calibration_targets + conformal gate), not detection. Enforced by dataforge.bench.check_coverage_regression.
source: dataforge bench --quick (full RAHA, pinned revision 7be1334b8c7bbdac3f47ef514fb3e1e8c5fc181c); floors refreshed 2026-07-07. rayyan floors added 2026-07-11 from a measured offline run (missing_value@detection 1.00 -> floor 0.90; datetime_format@detection 0.12 -> floor 0.10). tax (200k rows) is impractically slow for the quick heuristic bench, so no tax floor is seeded rather than fabricated.

_frontier_map._doc: Honest detectable-vs-abstention classification of undetected slices (measured 2026-07-11, cells inspected before any detector was built). DETECTABLE = the correct value is inferable in-table, so a precise additive detector can flag it. ABSTENTION = the correct value is NOT inferable from the data (e.g. a different actual time), so flagging-by-guessing would be dishonest; the honest path is calibrated abstention, not detection.

flights.value_format: DETECTABLE (time wrapped in date/timezone cruft; TimeFormatCruftDetector -> detection 0.40, 0 false positives; residual are different-time value errors)
flights.text_normalization: ABSTENTION (n=1729 act_dep/arr_time value errors mislabeled by string edit-distance; different times, not inferable)
flights.other: ABSTENTION (n=678 different act/sched times; not inferable in-table)

rayyan.datetime_format: PARTIAL (n=722, detection 0.12; date-format variants; further detection possible but precision-sensitive)
rayyan.value_format: LIKELY ABSTENTION (n=107 free-text title/author punctuation reformat; precise detection risks false positives on free text)
